info.description: Real-time fleet management and order tracking system for PT. Jalur Berlian Makassar
info.title: Jalur Berlian Fleet Management API

get.description: Get list of all customers. All authenticated admins can access.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

post.description: Create a new business customer (company/PIC/contact). All authenticated admins can access.

parameters.description: Customer data: company_name, pic_name, phone, email, address, npwp
parameters.name: body

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token
Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

delete.description: Delete a customer by ID. All authenticated admins can access.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

patch.description: Update customer fields (partial). All authenticated admins can access.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

get.description: Get dashboard overview with order stats, truck count, user count, etc.
Get list of all drivers. All authenticated admins can access.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

post.description: Create a new driver. All authenticated admins can access.

parameters.description: Driver data: name, license_number, phone, status, is_active
parameters.name: body

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token
Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

delete.description: Deactivate a driver by ID. All authenticated admins can access.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

patch.description: Update driver fields (partial). All authenticated admins can access.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

get.description: Get all orders with pagination support. Returns list of orders sorted by order_date DESC.

200.description: Order list with count and pagination info

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

post.description: Create a new order with customer, origin, destination, and total containers. Status auto-set to 'pending'. Admin ID extracted from JWT.

parameters.description: Order details: order_number (required), customer_id (required), origin (required), destination (required), total_containers (required)
parameters.name: body

201.description: Order created successfully with id, order_number, customer_id, admin_id, origin, destination, total_containers, order_date, status

400.description: Bad request: invalid JSON or missing required fields

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

422.description: Unprocessable entity - failed to create order

get.description: Retrieve detailed information of a specific order by ID. Includes customer, admin, and status info.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

delete.description: Cancel a specific order. Order must be in 'pending' or 'partial' status to be cancelled.

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

409.description: Conflict - cannot cancel order (invalid status or already completed)

patch.description: Update the status of an order. Valid transitions: pending → partial/completed/cancelled, partial → completed/cancelled.

parameters.description: Status update: status (required, one of: pending, partial, completed, cancelled)
parameters.name: body

400.description: Bad request - invalid ID or status

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

get.description: Retrieve all trips (surat jalan) associated with a specific order ID. Shows trip number, status, truck, and driver assignments.

200.description: List of trips for the order

400.description: Bad request - invalid order ID format

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

patch.description: Update your own profile information (full_name and/or password). All authenticated admins can access. At least one field must be provided. Password must be at least 6 characters. User_id is extracted from JWT token.

parameters.description: Profile update data: full_name (optional), password (optional, min 6 chars). At least one required.
parameters.name: body

200.description: Profile updated successfully with message and updated user object (id, username, full_name, role, is_active, created_at)

400.description: Bad request: at least one field (full_name or password) must be provided, or password must be at least 6 characters

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

404.description: Not found - user not found in database

422.description: Unprocessable entity - failed to update profile

post.description: Create the first super_admin user in the system (one-time endpoint, auto-disabled after first use). Returns JWT token for immediate use. Only succeeds if no admin exists yet.

parameters.description: Admin setup credentials: username, password (min 6 chars), optional full_name
parameters.name: request

201.description: Super admin created successfully with JWT token. User object includes immutable id and auto-set created_at

400.description: Invalid request format or invalid credentials

get.description: Retrieve all trips (surat jalan) with their status, truck, and driver assignments. Sorted by creation date (newest first).

200.description: List of all trips with count

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

post.description: Create a new trip (surat jalan) for an order. Requires order_id, truck_id, driver_id, and trip_number. Allocates truck and driver for the order.

parameters.description: Trip details: order_id (required), truck_id (required), driver_id (required), trip_number (required)
parameters.name: body

201.description: Trip created successfully with trip_number, status (assigned), truck and driver allocated

400.description: Bad request - invalid JSON or missing required fields

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

404.description: Not found - order_id, truck_id, or driver_id tidak ada

409.description: Conflict - truck/driver inactive or invalid order status

patch.description: Complete a trip by marking it as delivered. Changes trip status from 'in_transit' to 'delivered'. Order status automatically updated to 'completed'.

200.description: Trip completed, status changed to delivered, order marked as completed

400.description: Bad request - invalid trip ID format

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

409.description: Conflict - cannot complete trip (invalid status or not in_transit)

patch.description: Start a trip by setting container_number and seal_number. Changes trip status from 'assigned' to 'in_transit'. Real-time tracking begins.

parameters.description: Trip start details: container_number and seal_number (both required)
parameters.name: body

200.description: Trip started, status changed to in_transit

400.description: Bad request - invalid ID or missing container/seal numbers

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

409.description: Conflict - cannot start trip (invalid status or already in_transit)

get.description: Get all trucks with pagination support

post.description: Register a new truck in the fleet

parameters.description: Truck details: plate_number, truck_type, status, is_active
parameters.name: truck

get.description: Retrieve a specific truck by ID

delete.description:
Deactivate a truck from fleet
Deactivate a truck by setting is_active to false (soft delete). Truck must not have any active trips.

409.description: Conflict - truck still has active trips

patch.description: Update truck details with PATCH support. Only provide fields you want to update (all fields are optional).

parameters.description: Truck fields to update (only include fields you want to change)
parameters.name: truck

200.description: Truck updated successfully with actual data from database

get.description: Get list of all users with their username, role, and active status (password_hash excluded). Only super_admin can access. Returns message, count, and data array.

200.description: Success response with message, count, and data array of users (each user has id, username, full_name, role, is_active, created_at)

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

post.description: Create a new internal admin user with username, password, and role. Only super_admin can access. Full_name defaults to username if not provided. Password must be at least 6 characters.

parameters.description: User creation data: username (required), password (required, min 6 chars), full_name (optional), role (required: super_admin, admin_sales, or admin_ops), is_active (optional, default true)
parameters.name: body

201.description: User created successfully with user object containing id, username, full_name, role, is_active, created_at

400.description: Invalid input: username required, password required, password must be at least 6 characters, role must be one of: super_admin, admin_sales, admin_ops

401.description: Unauthorized - missing or invalid JWT token

422.description: Unprocessable entity - failed to create user

post.description: Login with username and password to receive JWT token. Token is valid for 24 hours. Use token in Authorization: Bearer header for subsequent requests.

200.description: Login successful - returns token, expires_at timestamp, and user object

400.description: Bad request - invalid request format or missing username/password

401.description: Unauthorized - invalid username or password, or user inactive

post.description: Logout user (stateless JWT - server-side confirms, client discards token).

200.description: Logout successful - delete token from client storage

401.description: Unauthorized - missing Authorization header

get.description: Track order status and assignment without authentication. Returns order status, truck info, and real-time location

200.description: Order tracking data with truck and location info

get.description: Retrieve the most recent GPS location for a trip. Returns the latest coordinate point recorded.

200.description: Latest location record with lat, lon, speed, timestamp

400.description: Bad request - invalid trip ID format

404.description: Not found - no location recorded for this trip

500.description: Internal server error - failed to retrieve latest location

post.description: Save current GPS location for a trip. Accepts latitude, longitude, optional speed, and timestamp. Used for real-time vehicle tracking.

parameters.description: Location data: lat (float64 required), lon (float64 required), speed (float64 optional), ts (RFC3339 string optional, defaults to now)
parameters.name: body

400.description: Bad request - invalid trip ID or invalid lat/lon coordinates

get.description: Retrieve the location history for a trip. Returns all saved GPS coordinates in descending order (latest first). Supports pagination via limit parameter.

parameters.description: Max number of locations to return (default 50, max 500)
parameters.name: limit

200.description: Array of location records with lat, lon, speed, timestamp

400.description: Bad request - invalid trip ID format

500.description: Internal server error - failed to retrieve location history

full_name.description: Full name untuk display (optional, default = username jika kosong)
Full name untuk display (optional, default = username jika kosong)

is_active.description: Pointer untuk default true jika tidak dikirim

password.description: Password plain text (akan di-hash dengan bcrypt)
Update password (optional, minimal 6 karakter jika diisi)

Bearer.description: Type "Bearer" followed by a space and JWT token.
Bearer.name: Authorization
